LanguageData.FrameProfilerQuickAccess.ShowButtonOnlyI: Show button only in dev mode
When enabled, the frame profiler button in the bottom bar is hidden unless dev mode is on.
LanguageData.FrameProfilerQuickAccess.InstrumentTrivi: Allow the Frame Profiler to instrument methods Waylith classifies as trivial. Applies to all selected targets. Changing this refreshes active instrumentation and can take time with broad filters.
